app_usage: convert Bambu Studio 3MF materials for Snapmaker U1
flag_nozzle_usage: use the built-in U1 baseline for `DIAMETER_MM` instead of the source nozzle (allowed: 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8)
flag_template_usage: override the built-in U1 baseline with `FILE`
flag_mix_mode_usage: use `MODE` for generated mixtures (ratio, cycle, match, or gradient)
flag_subdivide_layer_height_usage: enable or disable all three Local-Z subdivision settings
flag_replace_usage: replace the output file when it already exists
flag_colors_usage: set current T1-T4 colors from four distinct c/m/y/g/w/b codes in `ORDER`
flag_full_spectrum_usage: synthesize source colors from the four loaded filaments
error_invalid_palette: invalid color order %q; use four distinct c/m/y/g/w/b codes
error_invalid_mix_mode: unsupported mix mode %q (allowed: ratio, cycle, match, gradient)
error_color_plan_interactive_required: color-plan review requires an interactive terminal
prompt_generate_full_spectrum: Source declares %d colors; %d need mixing. Generate them with full-spectrum mixing?
confirm_non_interactive: cannot ask for confirmation without an interactive terminal
color_plan_non_interactive: cannot review the color plan without an interactive terminal
color_plan_requires_source_output_and_mo: color order review requires source colors, output colors, and mix modes
color_plan_requires_source_and_output: color order review requires source and output colors
color_plan_physical_slots_required: output color sequence must keep physical colors in T1-T4
color_plan_mix_mode_out_of_range: mix mode selection is out of range
color_plan_replacement_out_of_range: color replacement is out of range
color_plan_mix_modes_required: mixed color review requires mix modes
